registration: Frozen before extended physical-length predictions; all original global shapes and a0 values retained. Existing local summaries and galaxy development results are exposed; no independent confirmation claim.
length_selection: Fixed decades from 100 pc to 1 Mpc probe disk and cluster scales that the original compact-system grid did not cover. Zero and 10 pc are repeated controls. These are global constants, never per-object fitted lengths. Preserve the original scan and all numerical or local-summary failures.
epsilon_reason: The new action uses the excess itself, so its epsilon-dependent constant can affect the force. Smaller regulator frozen before physical predictions; convergence checked explicitly.
boundary: Point Newtonian source plus constant external Newtonian field. Physical background mapped from the exact h=0 scalar limit. Zero anomalous central integration mass for the monopole.
controls: High-precision kernel derivatives; full Cartesian versus analytic point flux; radial variation; periodic action variation and momentum; ell=0 independent scalar quadrupole; independent infinite-domain action/flux quadrupole integrals.
classification: No classification when numerical gates fail. Near-edge numerical spread is descriptive, not a rigorous error bound. Both declared Galactic backgrounds and all six monopole orbits required for the combined summary screen.
claim_ceiling: Conditional historical summary screen only. No full Solar System pass, observed galaxy/cluster/lensing success, dynamical stability or new fundamental law established.
observations_access: Previously exposed published summaries only. No new raw or reserved measurements.
extension_scope: 45 new global cards and 18 repeated controls. Conditional local summary screening precedes galaxy/cluster prediction; no full Solar System admission and no replacement of the retained 54-card campaign.
